subject: 2025 MCAS Data and Accountability Targets
overview: Lisa Kingsley presented an analysis of Medford's 2025 MCAS performance, highlighting that the district is meeting minimum expectations but trailing in progress toward accountability targets.

items.title: 2025 MCAS Performance Presentation
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley reported that Medford met minimum expectations for 2025 but achieved only 45% of its accountability targets, necessitating a renewed focus on student data to improve progress.
